newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for June 18.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for June 18.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open on Wednesday, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1000 local/1500 GMT daily meteorological report.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Pacific Coast, Gulf of Mexico and Caribbean.

Clear skies and warm temperatures with winds 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 16 miles per hour) and waves three to five feet high. Possible rains along coasts of Colima, Jalisco, Michoacan, Guerrero, Oaxaca and Chiapas.
Cooler weather and possible light rains along the coast of Tamaulipas state. Winds from 10 to 15 knots and waves three to six feet high.
Cloudy with medium rains along the coasts of Nicaragua, Costa Rica and Panama.
Tropical storm off the coast of Honduras heading west at 10 to 15 knots. A separate storm spotted off coast of Venezuela moving west at speed of 10 knots.
In Mexico regional winds 10 to 15 knots and waves three to six feet high.
